text: Rohan, welcome to Month 4. Plan v1.2 starts today: 3 strength sessions weekly, 1 mobility session, and refined nutrition with lighter evening meals.
Three strength sessions sounds like a step up. How long should each be?
Each session will be around 25 minutes. Moderate load — bodyweight plus resistance bands. We'll progress gradually.
Completed two strength sessions this week. Felt tougher but manageable.
Perfect. That's the adaptation we want. Just keep recovery routines consistent.
Feeling a bit more tired this week. Waking HRV dropped to 52ms.
Noted. That can happen when load increases. Let's add an extra rest day if needed and push mobility instead of full strength.
Took a rest yesterday, HRV bounced back to 56ms today.
That's a good response. Keep alternating load and rest to maintain balance.
Work deadlines this week. Sleep is down to 5 hours on some nights.
Thanks for flagging. Keep BP and HRV logs daily this week. If HRV dips below 50 consistently, we'll scale back intensity.
That's lower than we want. Skip strength today. Do a 20-minute walk and breathing instead.
Slept 7 hours last night. HRV back up to 55ms this morning.
Perfect — shows you're responsive. Let's hold this balance for the rest of the week.
BP readings this week have averaged 124/78. HRV is consistently 56-59ms.
That's stable and right where we want it. Good work staying consistent despite workload stress.
Month 4 summary: you've adapted to Plan v1.2, strength consistency is good, recovery has held steady. Next month we'll keep the structure but integrate more endurance activity.
Thanks. I feel stronger overall. Ready to add endurance next month.
